mapper.sql: SELECT aa.act_att_idx AS actAttIdx, aa.act_idx AS actIdx, aa.file_name AS fileName, aa.stored_name AS storedName, aa.file_size AS fileSize, aa.content_type AS contentType, CAST(aa.attached_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS attachedAt, CAST(aa.modified_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS modifiedAt, aa.modified_by AS modifiedBy, um.user_name AS modifiedByNm, aa.deleted_yn AS deletedYn FROM active_att aa LEFT JOIN user_mst um ON um.user_id = aa.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(aa.file_size), 0) FROM active_att aa WHERE aa.act_idx = #{actIdx} AND aa.deleted_yn = false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO active_att ( act_idx, file_name, stored_name, file_size, content_type, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{actIdx}, #{fileName}, #{storedName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{modifiedBy} )
